thinkle_host_again_1.direction: [excited] Another chapter! [cheerful] Turn the page, my friends.
thinkle_host_again_1.text: Another chapter! Turn the page, my friends.

thinkle_host_again_2.direction: [cheerful] Every piece is home again. Off we go!
thinkle_host_again_2.text: Every piece is home again. Off we go!

thinkle_host_again_3.direction: [curious] Again? [excited] Splendid! I'll fetch a fresh candle.
thinkle_host_again_3.text: Again? Splendid! I'll fetch a fresh candle.

thinkle_host_again_4.direction: [curious] Round two... or three? [laughs] I've lost count!
thinkle_host_again_4.text: Round two... or three? I've lost count!

thinkle_host_black_wins_1.direction: [triumphant] Black wins! [cheerful] What a tale you two have told.
thinkle_host_black_wins_1.text: Black wins! What a tale you two have told.

thinkle_host_black_wins_2.direction: [triumphant] Victory to Black, and a bow to White!
thinkle_host_black_wins_2.text: Victory to Black, and a bow to White!

thinkle_host_black_wins_3.direction: [cheerful] The stars smile on Black, [mischievously] and wink at White!
thinkle_host_black_wins_3.text: The stars smile on Black, and wink at White!

thinkle_host_capture_1.direction: [excited] Aha! A capture, and the tale takes a twist.
thinkle_host_capture_1.text: Aha! A capture, and the tale takes a twist.

thinkle_host_capture_2.direction: [whispers] A piece bows out, ever so politely.
thinkle_host_capture_2.text: A piece bows out, ever so politely.

thinkle_host_capture_3.direction: [curious] Hmm... a capture. [cheerful] I'll note that in my scrolls.
thinkle_host_capture_3.text: Hmm... a capture. I'll note that in my scrolls.

thinkle_host_capture_4.direction: [cheerful] Splendid! One more piece for the box.
thinkle_host_capture_4.text: Splendid! One more piece for the box.

thinkle_host_capture_5.direction: [mischievously] Poof! Away it floats, like a little spell.
thinkle_host_capture_5.text: Poof! Away it floats, like a little spell.

thinkle_host_capture_6.direction: [laughs] Taken! My spectacles saw it all.
thinkle_host_capture_6.text: Taken! My spectacles saw it all.

thinkle_host_capture_heavy_1.direction: [gasps] Goodness me! My beard stood on end!
thinkle_host_capture_heavy_1.text: Goodness me! My beard stood on end!

thinkle_host_capture_heavy_2.direction: [excited] Stars and scrolls! What a capture!
thinkle_host_capture_heavy_2.text: Stars and scrolls! What a capture!

thinkle_host_capture_heavy_3.direction: [triumphant] A chapter to remember, my friends!
thinkle_host_capture_heavy_3.text: A chapter to remember, my friends!

thinkle_host_capture_heavy_4.direction: [gasps] Great heavens! What a turn of events!
thinkle_host_capture_heavy_4.text: Great heavens! What a turn of events!

thinkle_host_capture_heavy_5.direction: [triumphant] That one will echo through the ages!
thinkle_host_capture_heavy_5.text: That one will echo through the ages!

thinkle_host_capture_queen_1.direction: [gasps] Whoosh! A queen, and my hat nearly flew off!
thinkle_host_capture_queen_1.text: Whoosh! A queen, and my hat nearly flew off!

thinkle_host_capture_queen_2.direction: [excited] A queen! Bards will sing of this for years.
thinkle_host_capture_queen_2.text: A queen! Bards will sing of this for years.

thinkle_host_capture_queen_3.direction: [laughs] Queen overboard! [excited] What a moment, my friends!
thinkle_host_capture_queen_3.text: Queen overboard! What a moment, my friends!

thinkle_host_capture_queen_4.direction: [gasps] Gracious me, a queen! [sighs] I must sit down.
thinkle_host_capture_queen_4.text: Gracious me, a queen! I must sit down.

thinkle_host_castling_1.direction: [excited] Castling! [cheerful] It takes a king and a rook on the dice.
thinkle_host_castling_1.text: Castling! It takes a king and a rook on the dice.

thinkle_host_castling_2.direction: [curious] The king steps aside, [excited] and his tower leaps over!
thinkle_host_castling_2.text: The king steps aside, and his tower leaps over!

thinkle_host_castling_3.direction: [cheerful] One move for two pieces! That is castling.
thinkle_host_castling_3.text: One move for two pieces! That is castling.

thinkle_host_draw_1.direction: [cheerful] Equals part as friends, as the old saying goes.
thinkle_host_draw_1.text: Equals part as friends, as the old saying goes.

thinkle_host_draw_2.direction: [sighs] Neither side wins. [cheerful] What a gentle ending!
thinkle_host_draw_2.text: Neither side wins. What a gentle ending!

thinkle_host_draw_3.direction: [excited] Level to the last! The stars applaud you both.
thinkle_host_draw_3.text: Level to the last! The stars applaud you both.

thinkle_host_empty_roll_1.direction: [curious] Hmm... not a single move on that roll.
thinkle_host_empty_roll_1.text: Hmm... not a single move on that roll.

thinkle_host_empty_roll_2.direction: [sighs] A roll with no move. [cheerful] It happens to us all!
thinkle_host_empty_roll_2.text: A roll with no move. It happens to us all!

thinkle_host_empty_roll_3.direction: [laughs] Blame the dice, my friends, not the player!
thinkle_host_empty_roll_3.text: Blame the dice, my friends, not the player!

thinkle_host_empty_roll_4.direction: [whispers] The dice kept their secrets this time.
thinkle_host_empty_roll_4.text: The dice kept their secrets this time.

thinkle_host_empty_roll_5.direction: [sighs] Even magic can't argue with the dice!
thinkle_host_empty_roll_5.text: Even magic can't argue with the dice!

thinkle_host_en_passant_1.direction: [whispers] From my oldest scrolls: [excited] the rule of en passant!
thinkle_host_en_passant_1.text: From my oldest scrolls: the rule of en passant!

thinkle_host_en_passant_2.direction: [mischievously] A pawn's secret move! [whispers] En passant, they call it.
thinkle_host_en_passant_2.text: A pawn's secret move! En passant, they call it.

thinkle_host_en_passant_3.direction: [gasps] En passant! Rarer than a blue moon.
thinkle_host_en_passant_3.text: En passant! Rarer than a blue moon.

thinkle_host_handoff_1.direction: [cheerful] The remote passes on, my friends. Black's turn.
thinkle_host_handoff_1.text: The remote passes on, my friends. Black's turn.

thinkle_host_handoff_2.direction: [excited] Hear ye, hear ye! The remote goes to Black.
thinkle_host_handoff_2.text: Hear ye, hear ye! The remote goes to Black.

thinkle_host_handoff_3.direction: [excited] Pass the wand! [laughs] I mean... the remote. Black's turn.
thinkle_host_handoff_3.text: Pass the wand! I mean... the remote. Black's turn.

thinkle_host_intro_1.direction: [curious] Hmm... the dice favour no one, young or old.
thinkle_host_intro_1.text: Hmm... the dice favour no one, young or old.

thinkle_host_intro_2.direction: [cheerful] Settle in, my friends. [whispers] A new tale begins.
thinkle_host_intro_2.text: Settle in, my friends. A new tale begins.

thinkle_host_intro_3.direction: [cheerful] White, you roll first. [mischievously] The stars are watching!
thinkle_host_intro_3.text: White, you roll first. The stars are watching!

thinkle_host_intro_4.direction: [excited] Welcome, you two! [laughs] May the best roll win.
thinkle_host_intro_4.text: Welcome, you two! May the best roll win.

thinkle_host_intro_5.direction: [mischievously] I promise: no spells from me, only dice!
thinkle_host_intro_5.text: I promise: no spells from me, only dice!

thinkle_host_promotion_1.direction: [whispers] Abracadabra! [excited] The pawn becomes something new.
thinkle_host_promotion_1.text: Abracadabra! The pawn becomes something new.

thinkle_host_promotion_2.direction: [cheerful] Ah, a promotion! A pawn no longer.
thinkle_host_promotion_2.text: Ah, a promotion! A pawn no longer.

thinkle_host_promotion_3.direction: [triumphant] The bravest pawn reached the far side!
thinkle_host_promotion_3.text: The bravest pawn reached the far side!

thinkle_host_promotion_4.direction: [laughs] Hats off to that little pawn! Splendid!
thinkle_host_promotion_4.text: Hats off to that little pawn! Splendid!

thinkle_host_white_wins_1.direction: [triumphant] White wins! [cheerful] A fine tale, told by you both.
thinkle_host_white_wins_1.text: White wins! A fine tale, told by you both.

thinkle_host_white_wins_2.direction: [triumphant] Victory to White, and a bow to Black!
thinkle_host_white_wins_2.text: Victory to White, and a bow to Black!

thinkle_host_white_wins_3.direction: [cheerful] The stars smile on White, [mischievously] and wink at Black!
thinkle_host_white_wins_3.text: The stars smile on White, and wink at Black!

thinkle_host_win_1.direction: [sighs] And that is the last page. [excited] What a story!
thinkle_host_win_1.text: And that is the last page. What a story!

thinkle_host_win_2.direction: [triumphant] The game is won! What splendid play, you two.
thinkle_host_win_2.text: The game is won! What splendid play, you two.

thinkle_host_win_3.direction: [cheerful] My scrolls will remember this one. Bravo!
thinkle_host_win_3.text: My scrolls will remember this one. Bravo!
